### Fixed
- **muster's egress on the kubernetes flavour reaches its MCP backends and DNS** (giantswarm/agent-platform#840). Every NetworkPolicy that selects muster makes its egress default-deny beyond their union, and `-muster-to-agent-manager` (and `-otlp-egress`) select it; `networkPolicy.musterInClusterMcpPorts` rendered only a CiliumNetworkPolicy, so on a cluster without Cilium muster's reach to the in-cluster MCP backends rested on muster's own chart policy, which opens in-cluster egress on 80/443 only. The kubernetes flavour now renders `<muster>-mcp-egress` as a NetworkPolicy: DNS, `musterInClusterMcpPorts` to every pod of the cluster (the counterpart of the cilium flavour's cluster entity) and each `networkPolicy.mcpBackends` entry on its ports. `make verify-mcp-backend-netpol` asserts that the union of the policies selecting muster reaches agent-manager, each backend and DNS.
